body:
I'm getting this now and the solution looks to be the same one proposed here.

```
ERROR in .../node_modules/instantsearch.js/es/lib/InstantSearch.d.ts(94,97):
94:97 Type 'typeof EventEmitter' is not a constructor function type.
    92 |  * It emits the 'render' event every time a search is done
    93 |  */
  > 94 | declare class InstantSearch<TUiState extends UiState = UiState, TRouteState = TUiState> extends EventEmitter {
       |                                                                                                 ^
    95 |     client: InstantSearchOptions['searchClient'];
    96 |     indexName: string;
    97 |     insightsClient: AlgoliaInsightsClient | null;
```

Both on Typescript 3.8.3 and 4.5.2 (this error message from 4.5.2). This also came up here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/4911 and required a different workaround. We're consuming this through vue-instantsearch.

I was just coming here to open this same PR to unblock our usage. Looks like we'll need to fork with this fix unless we can bring it in here.
